description: This file defines a custom ASP.NET Core MVC action filter named ValidatorActionFilter, which validates the model state before an action executes and returns a JSON-formatted errors response if validation fails.

classes.name: ValidatorActionFilter
classes.description: Implements a validation filter that checks the model state before executing a controller action and returns validation errors in JSON format if invalid.

methods.name: OnActionExecuting
methods.description: Checks if the incoming model state is valid. If not, constructs a JSON response with error details and sets the HTTP status code to 422.

methods.name: OnActionExecuted
methods.description: Empty implementation; required by IActionFilter interface but not used here.
